CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing relation to identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Identified content (C), its origin/presentation metadata (O) and separate status lines (D) appear for the same referents/times.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to identified content presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (colored sets) are listed for current and conditional candidate referents.

D.rationale: Content/color lines are presented separately from distinct origin/status lines for the same referents/times.

O.rationale: Origin/represented_time metadata and an explicit display orientation statement describe how content is organized/presented or accessed.
